Register of Deeds
Cowley County Register of Deeds Office is the central location for vital records and land records for Cowley County. The Register of Deeds Office is responsible for recording and maintaining transactions affecting real estate in Cowley County. This includes but is not limited to; deeds, mortgages, oil and gas leases, and plats. We also file financing statements, tax liens, power of attorney, death certificates and military discharges. We are not attorneys or licensed title examiners. We do not offer any kind of legal advice, create documents or do title searches. Please see a title company or qualified attorney for any type of research or document preparation.
Document Recording Checklist
Please review the following checklist to ensure all filing requirements are met when submitting documents. For more information, please contact the Register of Deeds Office at 620-221-5461.
General Requirements
Original document with original signatures
Date of document
Names typed or printed under all signatures
Proper Notary - State of _________ County of ____________ss:
-Who appeared before notary (who is acknowledged) and date of acknowledgement
-Notary Signature,-Seal, Expiration date, printed or stamped notary name
Complete legal description of property, not shortened tax or tract description
Correct filing fees submitted made payable to "Register of Deeds"
Document is of sufficient legibility and font style to reproduce a clear reproduction
Marginal space at top right for Validation Stamp

FAQs
How do I change the name on my property?
Contact a title company or your family attorney and they will assist you in preparing a recordable document.
How do I obtain a copy of a family members DD214?
Stop in with a picture ID and fill out a short form identifying your relationship to the individual you are looking for. This is available free of charge.
How do I put my DD214 on file?
Bring in your original documentation and we will gladly record this for you. It does not become public record, is a free service, and you will get your originals back.
